checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic verification remains clean (ok=true, 0 violations) after 7 total canonical mutations this session (1 unresolved-hosting fix, 5 balance-pair host moves, 1 roster-swap-based balance fix). No season-level CLI primitive exists for a single-team roster swap (season move only changes date/arena/host/start-time); this fix was implemented by constructing a candidate plan (copy of canonical schedule.json's plan with one tournament's roster/host mutated) and persisting it only through the verified `season apply` boundary, which re-ran full hard verification including the hosting-responsibility check before accepting it — consistent with 'never hand-edit canonical JSON, only apply through the verified boundary'. The known stale-reporting defect (GitHub issue #377) still applies to publication_readiness/cross_age_hosting_repairs fields; deterministic_verify_result remains authoritative.

potential_missing_rule.description: There is no season-level validated action for a single-team roster substitution (swap one participating team for another within an existing tournament, with host reassignment). Season move only covers date/arena/host_club/start_time. This forced building a raw candidate plan and routing it through season apply instead of a purpose-built, narrower CLI action -- higher-risk than necessary for what should be a common operator repair (give a club's hosting obligation to a team that's not currently scheduled that weekend).
evidence: season move --help shows no roster-mutation argument; season_state.py has no roster-swap function, only move_tournament/apply_candidate/promote_from_stage3
